final_message:
I fixed it. **Status:** Reproduced at a9269c6. I rebuilt the reporter's playground as a test. `<SubComponent>` sits next to a `v-if` slot template inside `<BaseLayout>`. `#title` renders, but `#_duration` shows its fallback. It also fails when the `v-if` is false.

**Cause:** in `packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts`, `assignSlots` copies compiled slots onto the instance. When it isn't running in optimized mode, it skips every key that passes `isInternalKey`, and that matches *any* key starting with `_`. So the user's `_duration` slot was dropped along with the compiler markers (`_` and `__`). Here a dynamic slot (the `v-if`) on the parent component makes its default slot render with optimizations turned off, so `SubComponent` gets mounted that way. The check for stale slots in `updateSlots` had the same problem: a `_foo` slot added later with `v-if` would never be removed.

**Fix:** a new `isCompilerMarkerKey` (`'_'` or `'__'`) is now used in `assignSlots` and in the stale-slot check in `updateSlots`. I left `normalizeObjectSlots` alone, so render-function slot objects still ignore `_`-prefixed keys. An existing test (`componentSlots.spec.ts`, "should normalize object slots") relies on that.

**Test:** I added `packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlot.spec.ts`, which compiles the templates at runtime. It covers the reporter's layout with `v-if` true and false, plus an underscore slot that is added, removed and added again. All 3 cases fail without the fix and pass with it. Unit tests for runtime-core, vue, server-renderer, compiler-core and compiler-sfc pass (2434), and ESLint, Prettier and `tsc` are clean.

Run: `npx vitest run --project unit packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlot.spec.ts`
patch:
diff --git a/packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts b/packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts index 6114f6c..9296af6 100644 --- a/packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts +++ b/packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts @@ -88,6 +88,10 @@ export type RawSlots = { const isInternalKey = (key: string) => key[0] === '_' || key === '$stable' +// compiled slots may legitimately be named with a leading underscore (#13611), +// so only skip the actual compiler markers when copying them +const isCompilerMarkerKey = (key: string) => key === '_' || key === '__' + const normalizeSlotValue = (value: unknown): VNode[] => isArray(value) ? value.map(normalizeVNode) @@ -180,7 +184,7 @@ const assignSlots = ( // when rendering the optimized slots by manually written render function, // do not copy the `slots._` compiler flag so that `renderSlot` creates // slot Fragment with BAIL patchFlag to force full updates - if (optimized || !isInternalKey(key)) { + if (optimized || !isCompilerMarkerKey(key)) { slots[key] = children[key] } } @@ -252,7 +256,7 @@ export const updateSlots = ( // delete stale slots if (needDeletionCheck) { for (const key in slots) { - if (!isInternalKey(key) && deletionComparisonTarget[key] == null) { + if (!isCompilerMarkerKey(key) && deletionComparisonTarget[key] == null) { delete slots[key] } } diff --git a/packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlot.spec.ts b/packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlot.spec.ts new file mode 100644 index 0000000..b42af90 --- /dev/null +++ b/packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlot.spec.ts @@ -0,0 +1,58 @@ +import { createApp, nextTick, ref } from '../src' + +// #13611 +describe('slots whose name starts with an underscore', () => { + const SubComponent = { + template: ` +
title fallback
 +
_duration fallback
`, + } + const BaseLayout = { + template: `
`, + } + + test.each([true, false])( + 'renders provided content next to a v-if slot (v-if=%s)', + cond => { + const container = document.createElement('div') + createApp({ + components: { SubComponent, BaseLayout }, + data: () => ({ cond }), + template: ` + + + + + + + `, + }).mount(container) + expect(container.innerHTML).toContain('title works') + expect(container.innerHTML).toContain('_duration works') + expect(container.innerHTML).not.toContain('fallback') + }, + ) + + test('dynamic underscore slot is added and removed', async () => { + const container = document.createElement('div') + const show = ref(true) + createApp({ + components: { SubComponent, BaseLayout }, + setup: () => ({ show }), + template: ` + + + + + + `, + }).mount(container) + expect(container.innerHTML).toContain('_duration works') + show.value = false + await nextTick() + expect(container.innerHTML).toContain('_duration fallback') + show.value = true + await nextTick() + expect(container.innerHTML).toContain('_duration works') + }) +})
run_command: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile && npx vitest run --project unit packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlot.spec.ts
